slides.title: Things actually worth the money as a contractor
slides.body: Some obvious. Some boring. All of them pay for themselves.

slides.title: A good ladder.
slides.body: The cheap one costs more the day it fails.

slides.title: Renewing your license before it lapses.
slides.body: Not after the GC asks why your number doesn't look up.

slides.title: A current COI ready to send.
slides.body: Every GC asks. Have it before they do.

slides.title: Knowing when your bond and workers' comp renew.
slides.body: Two dates that quietly hold up a lot of jobs.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: License. COI. Bond. Workers' comp.
slides.body: Check the dates tonight, before a GC checks them for you.
